fields.description: Stored XOR16 checksum of the 0x538-byte save block, seed 0xFFFF.
fields.evidence: FUN_0800acf8 computes func_0x0804404c XOR16 fold (seed _DAT_0804406c=0xFFFF) over save-file offsets [2,0x538); FUN_0800ad14 validates it against save offset 0 on load; FUN_0800afb0 stamps it at save offset 0 on store. Verified: seed 0xFFFF reproduces stored 0x5027 in samples/baseline.sav.
fields.name: save_checksum

fields.description: Validation tag stamped on every save and mirrored at the end of the block.
fields.evidence: FUN_0800afb0 writes constant _DAT_0800b000 (0x1213 in baseline) to save offsets 2 and 0x534; FUN_0800ad14 load path requires save offset 2 to match and to equal save offset 0x534. Baseline has 0x1213 at both offsets.
fields.name: save_tag

fields.description: Gameplay option/config value in the 0x88 save window.
fields.evidence: FUN_0800adf8 initializes the save buffer region based at file offset 0x88 (puVar1=_DAT_0800aec0 maps +0x230 to stock fields at 0x2b8, +0xe to this offset); FUN_0800aec8/FUN_0800aefc shuttle the 0x88 window between the save buffer and game RAM via CpuSet (SWI 0xb); FUN_0800af30 boot path reads an option byte through a save-derived pointer. Baseline holds 0x0002, matching a small option/counter semantic.
fields.name: option_slot_a

fields.description: Gameplay option/config value next to option_slot_a.
fields.evidence: Same 0x88-window init/shuttle call chain as option_slot_a (FUN_0800adf8, FUN_0800aec8, FUN_0800aefc, boot read in FUN_0800af30). Baseline holds 0x0001.
fields.name: option_slot_b

fields.description: First of three stock/counter values (99 each) ahead of the 0x2c4 window.
fields.evidence: FUN_0800adf8 writes 99 three times via *(u16*)(puVar4+uVar6+0x8c) for uVar6 in 0..2, landing at save offsets 0x2b8, 0x2bc, 0x2c0 (puVar4=_DAT_0800aec0 is the save buffer base for the 0x88 region, byte stride 4). Baseline holds 99 (0x63) at all three offsets.
fields.name: stock_count_0

fields.evidence: Same FUN_0800adf8 triple-99 init as stock_count_0 (save offset 0x2bc). Baseline holds 99.
fields.name: stock_count_1

fields.evidence: Same FUN_0800adf8 triple-99 init as stock_count_0 (save offset 0x2c0). Baseline holds 99.
fields.name: stock_count_2

fields.description: Low half of the 32-bit record value at the head of the 0x2c4 window.
fields.evidence: FUN_0800ad90 writes *puVar1=0x1000 (puVar1=_DAT_0800adc8 maps to save offset 0x2c4: bytes 00 10 00 00 in baseline); FUN_0800aec8/FUN_0800aefc shuttle save offset 0x2c4 window with game RAM. Default 0x1000 preserved in baseline.
fields.name: record_base

fields.description: Select/index value in the 0x2c4 window; default 0x28, currently 0x0000 in the live capture.
fields.evidence: FUN_0800ad90 writes default 0x28 to save offset 0x2c6 (*(u16*)(_DAT_0800adc8+2)); baseline shows 0x0000, i.e. gameplay overwrote the default. Same 0x2c4-window shuttle (FUN_0800aec8/FUN_0800aefc).
fields.name: venue_select

fields.description: Low half of the 32-bit record/total value in the 0x2c4 window (full default 0x4000).
fields.evidence: FUN_0800ad90 writes puVar1[1]=0x4000 to save offset 0x2c8 (bytes 00 40 00 00 in baseline); shuttled with game RAM by FUN_0800aec8/FUN_0800aefc. Default low half 0x4000 preserved in baseline.
fields.name: record_total_lo

fields.description: High half of the 32-bit record/total default (0x0000).
fields.evidence: Upper half of the puVar1[1]=0x4000 write by FUN_0800ad90 at save offset 0x2ca; baseline holds 0x0000.
fields.name: record_total_hi

fields.description: Recorded value written by gameplay into the 0x2c4 window (0x28 observed).
fields.evidence: Save offset 0x2cc is not written by the FUN_0800ad90/FUN_0800adf8 defaults yet holds 0x0028 in samples/baseline.sav, so a gameplay caller stored it; it persists through the FUN_0800aec8/FUN_0800aefc 0x2c4-window shuttle and the FUN_0800ad54 dual-copy SRAM write.
fields.name: venue_record

fields.evidence: FUN_0800ad90 writes *(u16*)(puVar1+3)=2 to save offset 0x2d0; baseline holds 0x0002.
fields.name: progress_value_a

fields.description: Gameplay progress/config value in the 0x2c4 window.
fields.evidence: FUN_0800ad90 writes *(u16*)(puVar1+5)=6 to save offset 0x2d8; baseline holds 0x0006. Shuttled with game RAM by FUN_0800aec8/FUN_0800aefc.
fields.name: progress_value_b

fields.description: Gameplay progress/config value in the 0x2c4 window (default 0x68).
fields.evidence: FUN_0800ad90 writes *(u16*)(puVar1+0x16/2 equivalent byte +0x16)=0x68 to save offset 0x2da; baseline holds 0x0068.
fields.name: progress_value_c

fields.evidence: FUN_0800ad90 writes *(u16*)(puVar1+6)=1 to save offset 0x2dc; baseline holds 0x0001. Boot flag bit ops in FUN_0800af30 (FUN_0800ac88 clear 0xdc, FUN_0800acac test 0xdb) show nearby flag-bit gameplay.
fields.name: play_mode_flag

fields.evidence: FUN_0800ad90 writes *(u16*)(puVar1+7)=5 to save offset 0x2e0; baseline holds 0x0005.
fields.name: clear_stage

fields.evidence: FUN_0800ad90 writes *(u16*)(puVar1 byte +0x1e)=7 to save offset 0x2e2; baseline holds 0x0007.
fields.name: festival_rank

fields.description: End-of-block mirror of save_tag used by load validation.
fields.evidence: FUN_0800afb0 stamps _DAT_0800b000 to save offset 0x534 (*(u16*)(puVar1+_DAT_0800b004)); FUN_0800ad14 requires it to equal save offset 2. Baseline has 0x1213 here, matching save_tag.
fields.name: save_tag_mirror
